title: Asiad: PH’s Madis, Aludo beat Indonesia to advance in women’s doubles

blocks.text: The Philippines’ Tenny Madis and Stefi Aludo advanced to the next round of the tennis women’s doubles of the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games after defeating Indonesia’s Anjali Junarto and Meydiana Reinnamah, 6-3, 7-6 (4), on Monday at the Higashiyama Park Tennis Center in Japan.
